prepare_command: uv run python scripts/validation_lab.py prepare --output artifacts/native-lab-select.json --fixtures tests/fixtures

checks.command: uv run pytest tests/test_browser_contracts.py::test_select_descriptor_tracks_identity_and_effective_state tests/test_browser_contracts.py::test_multiple_select_is_evidence_only tests/test_browser_contracts.py::test_select_rejects_changed_observed_option tests/test_browser_contracts.py::test_select_uncertainty_never_retries tests/test_browser_contracts.py::test_select_protocol_epoch_is_not_progress tests/test_browser_contracts.py::test_only_tagged_preinput_rejection_is_stale tests/test_browser_contracts.py::test_multiselect_evidence_changes_progress tests/test_agent.py tests/test_execution_contracts.py tests/test_mcp_server.py tests/test_validation_harness.py -q
uv run python scripts/validation_lab.py close --manifest artifacts/native-lab-select.json

scope: Only candidate source changed. No paid APIs, external fixture traffic, commit or push. Later SNAPSHOT/LIMITS stages not implemented.
details: Descriptors pin actual select/option identity, tree index, meaning, effective disabled state, document and cache epoch.
Atomic SELECT validates page and target context, visibility and hit test before selectedIndex plus exactly one input/change pair.
Only explicit rejected_before_input is stale; dispatched uncertainty is terminal, preserves exact option intent, and never retries.
Multiple selects and native role-bearing descendants offer no mutation; all selected values remain read-only evidence.
Typed SELECT timeout still permits best-effort MCP dialog dismissal without repeating selection.
